verdict.rationale: Viam's Registry ships ready-made drivers for cameras, motors, sensors, arms and other hardware, with standard component APIs (e.g., GetImage()) providing consistent, standardized message/method interfaces across brands, and docs explicitly reference searching by hardware type like webcams and specific models. This directly matches bring-up of cameras/sensors with standard interfaces, though lidar/IMU/GPS-specific driver examples aren't named individually. Missing for 10: explicit named examples of lidar, IMU, and GPS driver models in the registry, and independent/hands-on confirmation of driver quality across these exact sensor types.
